findings.issue: Feminine הימנית can agree with בהן or with common-gender יד; Spanish 'la derecha' agrees only with mano, so 'right' is fixed on the hand.
findings.spanishSpan: pulgar de su mano la derecha

findings.issue: Verbless אשר על־כפו is 'que sobre su palma' with no clause break before the next על, so that destination of נתן can be read as still inside the relative.
findings.spanishSpan: que sobre su palma sobre lóbulo

notes: Other tokens match in order, number, person, and repetition.
